title: Conda channel list relies on `defaults`
description: .condarc declares a channel list that still contains `defaults`. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a channel list that still contains `defaults`.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a channel list that still contains `defaults`.
limitation: It matches a channel list that still contains `defaults` in the parsed .condarc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
